title: Where to Get Tickets to Belle and Sebastian’s 30th Anniversary Tour Online
summary: The Scottish indie rock band hits the road in the U.S., with tour dates starting May 17.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

For the band’s 30th anniversary, Belle and Sebastian is on the road throughout the United States, with dates starting Sunday, May 17, at Knight Concert Hall in Miami and wrapping up Thursday, June 11, at The Masonic in San Francisco.

Additionally, Joanna Sternberg and The Ladybug Transistor are set to rotating support as the opening acts throughout the North American leg of the tour. Learn more about Belle and Sebastian tour dates here .

Shop Belle and Sebastian Tour Tickets at Ticketmaster

The Scottish indie rock band is celebrating the 30th anniversary of their first two albums, Tigermilk and If You’re Feeling Sinister , both released in 1996.

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find Belle and Sebastian tickets online is through third-party sites, including StubHub , SeatGeek , Vivid Seats , Event Tickets Center , Gametime and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert.

In addition, Billboard likes that tickets are all delivered digitally, so you can get them sent instantly to your smartphone or email. Prices may also be above or below face value at times.
